# wohnmohr

> wohnmohr is a product company. It builds and runs a growing suite of focused software for everyday jobs (current products are listed below). It does not offer client services.

## Site
- Home: https://wohnmohr.com/
- Products: https://wohnmohr.com/products/
- About: https://wohnmohr.com/about/
- Brand: https://wohnmohr.com/brand/

## Our products
- Split Biller: split bills in ₹ and settle with UPI; no signup, no app download (live): https://www.splitbiller.com
- NicheLinq: one link, QR code and shop screen for a small business's offers, each with a pay, order, book or call button (live): https://nichelinq.com
- ChargeMyAI: add AI to a web app with one script tag; users pay per reply over UPI and the developer earns a share (early access): https://chargemyai.com
- MyThreadPay: piece-rate and daily wages for garment, carton and construction units; records pieces and attendance, works out weekly pay; English and Tamil (early access): https://mythreadpay.com
